items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Walter Page, and Joe Keyes had me - ... Joe Keyes, Derwood Stewart (Deo Stewart), and Hot Lips Page and Dan Minor.

ctx.x: Now who was in this? This was a band that Basie had gotten from Bennie Moten and from Walter Page, and Walter Page came to get you, is that right?
Walter asked me to go to play with him. Of course Mac Washinton was going to play with Benny at the Harlem Club on 15th-La Salle. Ben Webster, Walter Page, and Joe Keyes had me -
Joe Keyes was a great trumpet player.
